# `company.purchase_order_lines`

Immutable ordered purchase order lines, item or account, with captured quantities and costs.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with document_id + revision_id + id | — | — | Revision-local line ULID. |
| `document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with document_id + revision_id + id | — | purchase_order_line_identities.document_id, purchase_order_revisions.document_id | Owning purchase order. |
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with document_id + revision_id + id, unique with revision_id + line_id, unique with revision_id + position | — | purchase_order_revisions.id | Immutable revision containing this line. |
| `line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with revision_id + line_id | — | purchase_order_line_identities.id | Stable line identity carried across revisions. |
| `position` | BIGINT | no | — | unique with revision_id + position | — | — | One-based ordered position within the revision. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this purchase order history was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this history. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this history. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | items.id | Item ordered; null on an expense-account line. |
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | accounts.id | Account the cost is destined for; null on an item line. |
| `description` | VARCHAR(2000) | yes | — | — | — | — | Entered line description; null when blank. |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | yes | — | — | — | — | Ordered quantity in millionths; null when the line is an amount alone. |

| `amount_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Positive home-currency amount ordered on this line. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | customers.id | Customer or job this cost is attributed to; null when unattributed. |
| `billable` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | Whether this cost is marked to be passed on to the named customer. |
